title: Raymond Brown's band and his trombone style
summary: He recalls trombonist Raymond Brown and his trumpeter brother Bat, a loud player in the style of Jim Robinson, now dead.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: There were so many different fellas I played with. Oh, Raymond Brown.
